hints.title: Graph Inversion
hints.text: Reverse all edges: reachability of node 0 from every node becomes reachability of all nodes from node 0.

hints.title: Monotonicity
hints.text: If reachability is achieved with maximum edge weight mid, all weights greater than mid also succeed.

hints.title: Binary Search and Reachability
hints.text: Binary search on maximum edge weight and verify if depth-first search from node 0 reaches all n nodes in reversed graph.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary searches on weight limits with linear graph traversals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining edge deletion combinations produces intractable combinatorial state.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) stores inverted graph adjacency list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inverts reachability to node 0 into traversal from node 0 and binary searches edge bound.
